newsitem.title: USA: Elder-Beerman Stores reorganization date upheld.
newsitem.headline: Elder-Beerman Stores reorganization date upheld.

text.p: Elder-Beerman Stores Corp said on Monday that it was pleased with a federal judge's decision not to accelerate the date by which the company must develop a reorganization plan.

In his ruling, Judge Walter Rice of U.S. Distric Court in Dayton, Ohio, supported an earlier bankruptcy court decision allowing the privately held company until August 18 to develop a reorganization plan. The ruling was in response to a June 11 filing by unsecured creditors that sought to move the date forward.
Elder-Beerman, a department store company, filed a Chapter 11 petition in October 1995.
